questions.question: The anatomical length of the scapula is measured between which two landmarks?

explanations.a: Incorrect. These processes are not used for measuring the anatomical length.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The glenoid cavity is not the upper landmark for anatomical length.
explanations.c: Correct. The anatomical length of the scapula is measured from the superior angle to the inferior angle.
explanations.d: Incorrect. These borders are used for breadth-related measurements.

questions.question: Which instrument is used to measure the anatomical breadth of the scapula?

explanations.a: Incorrect. An osteometric board is mainly used for measuring the length of long bones.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Measuring tapes are not sufficiently precise for this osteometric measurement.
explanations.c: Correct. Sliding or spreading calipers are used to measure the anatomical breadth of the scapula accurately.
explanations.d: Incorrect. A goniometer is used for measuring angles.

questions.question: The length of the spine of the scapula is measured from:

answers.c: Root of spine to base of acromion

explanations.a: Incorrect. This measures the anatomical length of the scapula.
explanations.b: Incorrect. These are separate processes of the scapula.
explanations.c: Correct. The spine length is measured from its root to the base of the acromion.
explanations.d: Incorrect. These landmarks are not used for measuring the spine.

questions.question: The length of the glenoid fossa is measured in which direction?

explanations.b: Incorrect. The glenoid fossa length is not measured in the antero-posterior direction.
explanations.c: Correct. The length of the glenoid fossa is measured in the supero-inferior direction.
explanations.d: Incorrect. There is no standard oblique measurement for glenoid length.

questions.question: Breadth of the glenoid fossa refers to the maximum:

explanations.b: Incorrect. Diagonal distance is not the standard measurement.
explanations.c: Correct. Glenoid breadth is measured as the maximum antero-posterior distance of the articular surface.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Medio-lateral is not the standard glenoid breadth measurement.

questions.question: The supraspinous angle of the scapula is measured between:

answers.c: Superior border and spine of scapula

explanations.a: Incorrect. These borders form the superior angle of the scapula.
explanations.b: Incorrect. These structures do not define the supraspinous angle.
explanations.c: Correct. The supraspinous angle is formed between the superior border and the spine of the scapula.
explanations.d: Incorrect. These landmarks are unrelated to the supraspinous angle.

questions.question: The infraspinous angle of the scapula is formed between the spine and the:

explanations.a: Incorrect. This forms the supraspinous angle.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The medial border is not used for this angle.
explanations.c: Correct. The infraspinous angle is formed between the spine and the lateral (axillary) border of the scapula.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The inferior angle is a point, not a border forming this angle.

questions.question: Which instrument is used to measure supraspinous and infraspinous angles?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Sliding calipers measure linear distances.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Spreading calipers measure distances between projecting points.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Osteometric boards are used for measuring bone lengths.
explanations.d: Correct. A goniometer is the standard instrument used to measure anatomical angles.

questions.question: While measuring the breadth of the glenoid fossa, which structure should be excluded?

explanations.a: Incorrect. The articular surface is the structure being measured.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The glenoid cavity itself is the area of interest.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The measurement is confined to the articular margins, excluding surrounding non-articular bone.
explanations.d: Correct. The supraglenoid tubercle is excluded because it is not part of the articular surface of the glenoid fossa.
